ohsc.name: OHSC (Hermes Obsidian System Control)
ohsc.description: Autonomous multi-agent control plane for an Obsidian vault. The Universal Capability Gateway exposes its agents/skills/Graphify Brain/MCP to external coding/AI agents via one command.

activation.note: Resolves D:\HOSC automatically from any directory.

graphify.purpose: Semantic knowledge-graph analysis of a vault.

operations.name: build_graph
operations.purpose: Build a semantic knowledge graph from a vault (read-only).

operations.name: query_graph
operations.purpose: Ask a natural-language question over the built graph.

operations.name: shortest_path
operations.purpose: Conceptual shortest path between two concepts (undirected).

operations.name: explain
operations.purpose: Explain why/how a concept relates to others (provenance).

operations.name: analyze
operations.purpose: Structural report: hubs, communities, orphans, stats.

graphify.safety: Read-only on the vault; artifacts written to OHSC workspace.

orchestrator.purpose: Plan -> execute -> review a natural-language request.

interfaces.mcp: graphify-mcp (Graphify's own MCP server, graph-navigation tools)

vault.note: The real vault is never modified by Graphify analysis.

safety: Never expose API keys (env-var names only).
Never modify the real vault without explicit authorization.
